cards.title: Attribution and revision boundaries
items: Separate context, tool faults, local choices, and guidance. Record changed conditions or uncertain attribution honestly.
Check the current base before backup and scoped edits; revise proposals if it changed. Installation and publication keep their own scope.

cards.title: No automatic evaluation or rule growth after every use
items: Ordinary reviews retain observations already seen; maintenance requires no extra reviewer or model experiment.
Count the guidance actually loaded together. Unmeasured cost stays unknown; no feedback is not success.
Later outcomes can also leave the proposed benefit uncertain.
